root_cause: The variable-input BUFZ boundary made a temporary netvector_t with default unsigned type. Port resizing later used that temporary's signedness, so signed 4-bit actuals zero-extended to 8-bit input ports. The same boundary split old VCD alias identifiers without changing any named signal's value stream.
fix: Pass sig->get_signed() to the BUFZ temporary netvector_t constructor; retain the physical input-port boundary. Refresh only vcd-dup's structural VCD gold after semantic comparison.
